name: Feature flags
usage: Declare one kill switch per spec phase: const switches = killSwitches({ phases: ["phase-1", "phase-2"], source: dbSource(query) }) (the kill_switch table, KILL_SWITCH_SQL, in a migration) or source: fileSource("/data/kill-switches.json") (a JSON file such as {"phase-2": false} on a mounted volume). A phase is on unless turned off (defaults can say otherwise). Wrap every route of a phase with switches.guard("phase-2", handler): while the phase is off it answers 404, like a route that does not exist. Serve await switches.clientFlags() to the UI and hide the phase's screens and links when false; hiding in the UI alone is not enough. Turn a phase off with setKillSwitch(query, "phase-2", false, "<who>") or by editing the file: it takes effect within refreshMs (5 s) with no redeploy or restart. If the source fails or hangs, the last good state is kept and onError is told. Background jobs of a phase check switches.isOn(phase) after await switches.current() and skip their work while it is off.
